name: InTents Cubing Anza-Borrego 2026

venue.name: Anza-Borrego Desert State Park
venue.address: 200 Palm Canyon Dr, Borrego Springs, CA 92004

information: # This competition is intended to be an overnight competition/camping trip. We ask that you please only register if you intend on staying overnight. WE WILL HAVE THE CAMPSITES AVAILABLE STARTING FRIDAY. You are encouraged to arrive Friday and enjoy the non-competing activities. This is not a typical event for first-time competitors. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/InTentsCubingAnzaBorrego2026#76647-competitor-responsibilities) tab. This competition is partnership with [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com): ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTkyMTIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b2bc7727f88f838068ec100afe336828b0efb343/logo.png)
